summary: Meta released xformers v0.0.33, adding a cutlass fused multi-head attention operator for Blackwell GPUs, support for flash-attention up to 2.8.3, an FA3 deterministic mode, and forward/backward pass overlap for DeepSeek-like communication/compute overlap.

practices.reason: Teams running attention-heavy workloads on Blackwell GPUs or using DeepSeek-style comms/compute overlap can adopt these kernel and scheduling improvements directly from the open-source library.
practices.quote: cutlass fmha Op for Blackwell GPUs

practices.reason: Bumping supported flash-attention package version is a dependency compatibility change worth tracking for teams pinning xformers versions.
